subject: Overlay points to an existing graph

messages.author: c5246646595bff41
messages.subject: Overlay points to an existing graph
parts:
Hello Group,
 
I am trying to add a sereis of points to an existing graph that uses geom_line to plot a line graph. The points need to be along the x axis with yaxis=0. The x values are Dates.
 
The code reads like so:
 
p<-ggplot(data=A,aes(x=Date,y=value))
p<-p+geom_line(aes(y=Var1,col="Var1"),size=1.5,linetype=1,colour=cbbPalette[1])
p<-p+geom_point(data=B,aes(x=P1,y=0))
 
So the question is how to overlay a s series of points on a y intercept=0 to an existing line graph?
 
 
Thank you
 
So far I get an error:
 
 
Error: Invalid input: date_trans works with objects of class Date only

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Overlay points to an existing graph
parts:
Hi:

I agree with Roman that geom_hline() may be a better option, but to
deal with your specific problem, it appears from the error message
that B$P1 is not a Date object.

By the way that you defined the base layer, x was set to be a Date
object and y a numeric object (presumably...we have no direct
information to verify that conjecture, which could have been provided
by str(A) or the data). By defining these in the base layer, **all
subsequent layers will expect a Date object for the x-variable and a
numeric object for the y**. If B$P1 is not a Date object, this would
explain the error message. You would need to convert it to a Date
object in B before invoking it inside a ggplot() call if your actual
intention is to plot those specific points at y = 0...but I'd think
about whether that is really necessary or if a simple reference line
at 0 would serve the same purpose.

Dennis
